title: Rule: refactor keeps tests; validation comes with tests
goal: A refactor passes the same unchanged tests before and after
acceptance: One line in core/AGENTS.md, Checks before you finish
privacy: Rule and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories; no personal data.
escalation: Rule text differing materially from the accepted draft goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one line and a release entry. Not a measurement.
